purpose: Tracks, per G20+ expansion candidate, whether each required source-authority category has an official source identified and/or verified on file. This file records research state only. It never grants publication status — that happens exclusively through the existing data/rules/<slug>.json six-gate pipeline.

intake_status_model_notes.not_started: No candidate authority has been identified for this category yet.
intake_status_model_notes.identified: A plausible official authority name is known (public knowledge), but no specific official source URL has been fetched, dated, or cited yet.
intake_status_model_notes.needs_verification: A source URL exists from prior internal research but has not been re-checked for current reachability/effective text under this intake process.
intake_status_model_notes.verified_on_file: A specific official source URL is already recorded in the corresponding data/rules/<slug>.json source_authorities and was live-verified during that entry's own research (per the existing six-gate pipeline) — restated here for tracking only, not re-verified by this file.
intake_status_model_notes.not_applicable: This source category is not currently believed to be needed for this candidate's currency-passage rules (starting assumption only, may change once research begins).

not_applicable_note: tax_treasury_ministry_source is marked not_applicable for every candidate below because no candidate in this G20+ intake round has an identified currency-passage rule that depends specifically on a tax/treasury/ministry source distinct from its central bank or customs authority. This may change during actual research; not_applicable is a starting assumption, not a permanent exclusion.

central_bank_or_monetary_authority.label: Banca d'Italia (with the European Central Bank / Eurosystem)
central_bank_or_monetary_authority.note: P8E-1 identified 2026-07-24: Banca d'Italia (bancaditalia.it) is Italy's monetary authority within the Eurosystem; the euro is legal tender and Italy maintains no exchange controls (free movement of capital, Art. 63 TFEU). Claim-specific Banca d'Italia / ECB sources for foreign-currency accounts, resident/non-resident transfers, capital movements, business settlement and regulated conversion providers to be mapped field-by-field at the publication-candidate review (P8E-2).

customs_or_border_authority.label: Agenzia delle Dogane e dei Monopoli (ADM), with Guardia di Finanza; Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 and D.Lgs 195/2008 sourced separately
customs_or_border_authority.note: P8E-1 live-verified 2026-07-24 via official ADM guidance and EC/EUR-Lex summaries: EU external-border cash declaration under Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 (EUR 10 000 or more; cash = banknotes/coins, cheques, traveller's cheques, prepaid cards, gold; accompanied carrier vs unaccompanied post/freight/courier; applies from 3 June 2021; repealed Reg 1889/2005). ITALY-SPECIFIC: national Legislative Decree 195/2008 EXTENDS the EUR 10 000 declaration to INTRA-EU movements (Italy to/from other EU countries), filed at customs offices at entry/exit; penalty EUR 300 up to 40% of the amount exceeding EUR 10 000 (per ADM guidance). ADM pages 403-block WebFetch and EUR-Lex is JS-gated here; exact article/page/form-number pinpointing deferred to P8E-2. URLs: adm.gov.it/portale/en/controlli-valutari-in-entrata-e-uscita-italia; taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/prohibitions-restrictions/eu-cash-controls_en; eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2018/1672/oj/eng. DISTINCT from the domestic cash-payment ceiling and from UIF AML reporting. P8E-2 done 2026-07-24: data/rules/italy.json CREATED (page_status verified, indexing_allowed false). Declaration fields pinpointed to primary sources — ADM Circular 12/2024 (07/05/2024) p.1 confirms Art. 3 Reg (EU) 2018/1672 (EU border) and Art. 3 D.Lgs 195/2008 (national territory / intra-EU), EUR 10 000, first border customs office; p.4 Art. 28 administrative seizure; ADM cash-declaration form p.1 (cash = currency, bearer instruments, gold). Capital/exchange/resident/non-resident/banking fields carry [HARDENING] (TFEU Art. 63 EUR-Lex JS-gated and Banca d'Italia landing generic — claim-specific primary not fetchable here). Italy HELD at source_review_ready; not publish_ready. Penalty figures NOT asserted (2012 Viaggi&Valuta edition superseded; current figures not pinned).

financial_intelligence_unit_or_aml_autho.label: Unità di Informazione Finanziaria per l'Italia (UIF), established within Banca d'Italia
financial_intelligence_unit_or_aml_autho.note: P8E-1 identified 2026-07-24: UIF (uif.bancaditalia.it) is Italy's FIU under D.Lgs 231/2007, receiving suspicious-transaction reports; AML/FIU context ONLY, not the traveller customs declaration. Separately, the DOMESTIC cash-payment ceiling (D.Lgs 231/2007 Art. 49; reportedly raised to EUR 5 000 from 1 Jan 2023 by the 2023 Budget Law — exact current figure to be pinned precisely at P8E-2) is a domestic payment limit, NOT the border cash-declaration rule and NOT a UIF report. Keep the four regimes strictly separate: EU/Italy border declaration (ADM), capital-movement freedom (Banca d'Italia/ECB), AML reporting (UIF), domestic cash ceiling (MEF/Banca d'Italia).
